title: Conectores formales: a raíz de, en el marco de

sections.content: A raíz de introduces what caused an interpretation to form; en el marco de places a case or claim inside the framework of a broader theory. Comparing two interpretations of the same phenomenon needs both. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A raíz de su propia experiencia como opositor exiliado, Sarmiento publicó 'Facundo: Civilización y Barbarie' en 1845.
items.english: As a result of his own experience as an exiled opponent, Sarmiento published 'Facundo: Civilización y Barbarie' in 1845.

items.spanish: En el marco de esa interpretación, el caudillismo quedó asociado casi automáticamente con el atraso y la barbarie.
items.english: Within the framework of that interpretation, caudillismo became almost automatically associated with backwardness and barbarism.

items.spanish: En el marco de casos como el de Rafael Carrera, esta interpretación resulta considerablemente más difícil de sostener.
items.english: Within the framework of cases like Rafael Carrera's, this interpretation becomes considerably harder to sustain.

items.spanish: A raíz de este tipo de apoyo popular genuino, algunos historiadores prefieren una interpretación distinta.
items.english: As a result of this kind of genuine popular support, some historians prefer a different interpretation.

sections.content: En el marco de is the connector of choice when you want to say "judged by this particular theory's own standards" — it lets you test an interpretation against a specific case without yet declaring whether the interpretation survives the test.
